units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sukkah 5:6">Succ. V, 6</cite> <he>חוזרין ח׳</he> they take turns all around.

<cite ref="Tosefta Zevahim 1:1">Tosef. Zeb. I, 1</cite> <he>חזרנו ח׳</he> we are moving in a circle, i.e. this way of arguing will lead to no conclusion; <cite ref="Zevachim 10b:6">Zeb. 10ᵇ</cite> <he>חוזרני ח׳</he> ed. I am moving &c.; a. e.
Gen. R. s. 49; Yalk. ib. 83 (expl. חללה, Gen. XVIII, 25), v. בָּרָאָה, a. חוֹל III; Tanḥ. Vayera 8 חֲלָלָה כתיב it may be read ḥălalah (desecration), לא חול הוא לך is it not too profane for thee?
